description: This file contains implementation code for time zone lookup functions within the Abseil C++ library, including platform-specific code for Android, Apple, Fuchsia, and others, as well as functions for loading and managing time zone data.

classes.name: time_zone
classes.description: Class representing a time zone with methods for name, lookup, transitions, version, and description.

methods.name: time_zone::name
methods.description: Returns the name of the time zone.

methods.name: time_zone::lookup
methods.description: Looks up the time zone information for a given time point.

methods.name: time_zone::lookup
methods.description: Looks up the time zone information for a given civil second.

methods.name: time_zone::next_transition
methods.description: Finds the next transition after a given time point.

methods.name: time_zone::prev_transition
methods.description: Finds the previous transition before a given time point.

methods.name: time_zone::version
methods.description: Returns the version string of the time zone data.

methods.name: time_zone::description
methods.description: Returns a description of the time zone.

methods.name: effective_impl
methods.description: Returns the effective implementation of the time zone, defaulting to UTC if none is set.

methods.name: load_time_zone
methods.description: Loads a time zone by name into the provided time_zone object.

methods.name: utc_time_zone
methods.description: Returns the UTC time zone object.

methods.name: fixed_time_zone
methods.description: Creates a fixed offset time zone.

methods.name: local_time_zone
methods.description: Determines the local time zone based on platform-specific APIs and environment variables.
